newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mint to buy 155 tonnes nickel from Phoenixx.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mint to buy 155 tonnes nickel from Phoenixx.

text.p: The U.S. Mint is expected to buy two lots of nickel totalling 155 tonnes from Phoenixx International at a premium of 9.50 to 10.00 cents over the LME cash price, sources said.
The next highest bidder was believed to be as much as 4.00 to 4.50 cents above Phoenixx's bid, one dealer said.
Spot premiums on a net cash basis are 9.00 to 11.00 cents over LME cash.
"The market is not a bleak as the price would seem to indicate," said one merchant. "We are in the middle of the summer and business is typically slower. But demand is not bad."
The LME cash price has fallen approximately 50 cents in the last two months. Wednesday's settlement was $3.03 a lb.
